name: War-Awoken Black Mage's Dual Memory (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒黒魔道士の記憶・双
effects:
Single-target Ice/Lightning/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Ice/Lightning Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least 0/2 En-Ice/Lightning members
WS Blue: Dualcast Ice/Lightning 3, Instant Ice/Lightning 3 & Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns to user
WS Gold: Dualcast Ice/Lightning 2, Instant Ice/Lightning 2 & Weakness Damage +30% for 2 turns to party
